verdict.rationale: Choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for a SaaS CRM like Salesmate, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, region selection, or where data is stored. Related items such as a dedicated email IP or the REST APIs are about other capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
